description: Render a release changelog section from merged pull requests, grouped by label in a fixed group order, as Markdown plus the grouped structure.

date.description: Release date, printed verbatim in the heading (not parsed)

group_order.description: Labels that define groups, in output order; a pull request joins the first of these labels it carries (optional, default ["feature", "bugfix", "documentation", "maintenance"])

heading_level.description: Markdown heading level for the version heading; group headings are one level deeper (optional, default 2)

pull_requests.description: Merged pull requests for the release (at least one)

labels.description: Labels on the pull request (optional, default [])

number.description: Pull request number (unique across the list)

version.description: Release version label, printed verbatim in the heading

name: generate_changelog
